core:
Use the attached APPROVED Lulli drawing as the exact character AND rendering master. Edit this same mascot into the specified pose. Preserve the same illustrator's hand; change only the necessary anatomy for the pose, with no redesign.

STYLE AND IDENTITY MUST REMAIN FIXED:
Delicate, thin medium-charcoal GRAY strokes, softly weighted and lower contrast than black. Interior lines are fine and gently tapering; the outer contour is only slightly stronger. Match the reference's grayness and thickness at equal display size. No bold black outlines.
Fur is described by sparse long smooth curves with large open gaps. Preserve the irregular pointed tufts and swept locks, but DO NOT add fur strands, hatching, stippling, pencil texture or shaded volume. Detailed SHAPES, sparse MARKS. The same flat lightly cartooned anatomy and adult proportions, never round baby-puppy proportions, never plush or realistic rendering.
Preserve the facial construction: large outlined circular eyes with unfilled interiors, small outlined nose with simple nostril curves, two rounded muzzle lobes, whisker curves, familiar broad open smile. Same spacing, ratios, ear lengths, swept forehead and curled plume tail. Eyes can close into simple delicate arcs only when the pose calls for it. No solid black eyes/nose, highlights, shading or added facial texture.
Keep the sparse pale pink and powder-blue flat organic graphic patches behind the dog. No new gradients or glow.
Keep transparent unfilled interior areas as in the reference: no opaque white fur fill. Actual alpha transparency, no drawn checkerboard, white/black background panel, cast shadow, words, UI or border.
Exactly ONE dog, with TWO forelegs and TWO hind legs total; paws holding a prop replace those paws' resting positions. Never add limbs or duplicate paws.
Landscape 3:2 PNG, complete intended silhouette with 6% safe margin. Preserve legible fine lines for mobile display.

poses.name: 01-welcome
poses.screen: Welcome — Big plans. Tiny first steps.
poses.pose: A warm introduction: Lulli sits front-facing with its familiar slight head tilt and open smile. BOTH front paws rest over the top edge of a small blank upright ivory card in front of its lower chest. The two hind paws are visible at the ground, the tail curls beside the body. Exactly two forepaws on the card, not extra waving paws. The card is a simple flat pale-ivory shape with a fine gray outline, without lettering; it occupies at most one quarter of the composition so the mascot remains dominant. Preserve the approved face almost unchanged. This is a new welcoming pose, not a wave.

poses.name: 02-focus
poses.screen: Choose a focus — What feels stuck today?
poses.pose: A calm reassuring companion: Lulli lies with its chin resting lightly across its two extended front paws, looking toward the viewer. Preserve the familiar outlined eyes and muzzle, gentle small open smile, swept long ears. Its narrow adult body extends to the viewer's right, hindlegs naturally tucked behind and mostly occluded, with the plume tail curving beside the body. Keep the same head/body proportions and sparse long fur contours. Do not shorten the ears or round the face into a puppy. No props. This low horizontal pose should feel patient and unhurried.

poses.name: 03-tiny-action
poses.screen: Try a tiny action — Put one thing back in its place.
poses.pose: Preserve the useful sock-and-basket action: Lulli sits in three-quarter view beside a small laundry basket on the viewer's left. ONE front paw reaches forward and gently holds a pale-pink sock just above the basket rim; its OTHER front paw rests on the ground. Two hindlegs support the seated body, partly occluded naturally. Exactly four limbs total; do not draw two grounded front paws plus an extra arm. Head faces toward the viewer with the approved outlined features and familiar smile. Basket is simply described by a few thin gray weave lines, without intricate texture, shading or lettering. Dog and basket remain separate legible forms. Keep all head and fur marks as sparse, light and delicate as the reference.

poses.name: 04-celebrate
poses.pose: Lulli sits and proudly hugs a small pale-yellow five-point star to its chest using BOTH FRONT PAWS. The only visible paws are TWO holding the star plus TWO hind paws resting on the ground: FOUR total. Absolutely no extra raised waving paws at the shoulders or behind the star. Keep the approved head, muzzle and nose proportions; close the eyes into thin joyful arcs and keep the broad smiling mouth. Same long ears, thin-gray sparse fur contours and curled tail. Add only a few tiny pink/blue outlined confetti stars around it. Star is flat, unshaded, secondary in size. No extra dense fur marks.

poses.name: 05-home
poses.screen: Home — One small thing at a time.
poses.pose: A friendly daily companion peeking up from the lower edge: show Lulli's familiar head, upper chest, and TWO front paws resting together on an imaginary low ledge. The ledge is not drawn; the two paws themselves establish a horizontal base. Lower body and hindlegs are outside this deliberately cropped bust composition, not extra visible limbs. Keep the approved slight head tilt, outlined eyes, simple outlined nose and open smile nearly unchanged. Long ears fall naturally beside the face; preserve sparse fine gray fur curves. Compact chest-up silhouette suited to the right side of the home header, with transparent background and no text or UI.
